title: 24B AI, 2B at a time
caption:
24 billion parameters… but only 2 billion working at a time 🤯

Riya asks, Arjun explains how 'mixture of experts' is bringing big AI to your devices, privately and offline:
1. Cloud AI vs on-device AI
2. Why memory is the real limit
3. Mixture of experts: the router trick
4. Quantization and the other tricks
5. What private on-device agents unlock
6. The reality check for phones today

Take the quiz ⏸️ and drop your answer below 👇

#ai #ondeviceai #llm #mixtureofexperts #edgeai #privacy #aiexplained #techeducation #aiwithsufi

lines.vo: Arjun, I read about an AI with twenty four billion parameters that's built to run on your own device. How is that possible?
lines.cap: A 24 BILLION parameter AI built for YOUR device. How?

lines.vo: Here's the trick. It only uses about two billion of them at a time. Let me show you how.
lines.cap: It only uses about 2 BILLION at a time. Let me show you.

lines.vo: Most AI today runs in the cloud. Your message travels to a giant data center, and the answer comes back.
lines.cap: Most AI runs in the CLOUD. Your message travels to a data center.

lines.vo: On-device AI runs on your own chip. Your data stays with you, and it even works offline.
lines.cap: ON-DEVICE AI runs on your chip. Data STAYS with you.

lines.vo: So why doesn't every phone just run a huge model?
lines.cap: So why not run a HUGE model on every phone?

lines.vo: Memory. A model has to fit in your device's memory before it can think at all.
lines.cap: MEMORY. The model must FIT before it can think.

lines.vo: Today, iPhones comfortably run models of around three billion parameters, and flagship Androids up to about seven.
lines.cap: iPhone: about 3B. Flagship Android: about 7B.

lines.vo: Liquid AI's new twenty four billion model is aimed at devices like laptops, where it runs very fast.
lines.cap: Liquid AI's 24B model targets devices like LAPTOPS.

lines.vo: Okay, so how does a big model run like a small one?
lines.cap: How does a BIG model run like a SMALL one?

lines.vo: It's called mixture of experts. The model is split into many smaller expert networks.
lines.cap: MIXTURE OF EXPERTS: many smaller EXPERT networks.

lines.vo: For every word, a router picks only the few experts it needs. The rest stay asleep, so it does far less work.
lines.cap: A ROUTER picks a few experts per word. The rest SLEEP.

scenes.label: QUIZ 1
scenes.question: The model is called LFM2.5-24B-A2B. What does 'A2B' mean?

lines.vo: Quiz time. The model's name ends in A two B. What does that mean?
lines.cap: QUIZ: The name ends in A2B. What does it MEAN?

lines.vo: Pause and guess. A, B, or C.
lines.cap: PAUSE and guess. A, B or C?

lines.vo: It's B. Two billion active parameters for each word. Twenty four billion in total.
lines.cap: B! 2B ACTIVE per word. 24B in TOTAL.

items.s: store each number in fewer bits
1B to 7B, trained to punch above their size
built into new phones and laptops

lines.vo: Trick two is quantization. Each number in the model is stored with fewer bits, so the whole model shrinks.
lines.cap: QUANTIZATION: fewer bits per number. The model SHRINKS.

lines.vo: Small models are also getting much smarter, and new phones have special AI chips called NPUs.
lines.cap: Smarter SMALL models, plus AI chips called NPUs.

lines.vo: So what can I actually do with it?
lines.cap: So what can I actually DO with it?

lines.vo: Imagine an assistant that reads your messages and calendar and plans your day, without uploading anything.
lines.cap: An assistant that plans your day WITHOUT uploading anything.

lines.vo: That's why Liquid AI built this model for private agents. Your data never has to leave your device.
lines.cap: PRIVATE agents. Your data never leaves your device.

scenes.label: QUIZ 2
scenes.question: Can today's iPhone run a 70B model on-device?

lines.vo: Second quiz. Can today's iPhone run a seventy billion parameter model?
lines.cap: QUIZ 2: Can today's iPhone run a 70B model?

lines.vo: No, not even close. Phones today stick to small models. But tricks like mixture of experts keep closing the gap.
lines.cap: NO. But tricks like MIXTURE OF EXPERTS keep closing the gap.

recap: Phones today: small models, growing fast

lines.vo: So big AI is moving closer to your pocket. Not by shrinking the brain, but by waking only the parts it needs.
lines.cap: Not a smaller brain. Just waking the PARTS it needs.
